mapper.select: select user_id, websocket_enabled, email_enabled, push_enabled, time_format(quiet_start, '%H:%i') quiet_start, time_format(quiet_end, '%H:%i') quiet_end from px_reminder_preference where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: insert into px_reminder_preference(user_id, websocket_enabled, email_enabled, push_enabled, quiet_start, quiet_end, update_time) values(#{userId}, #{websocketEnabled}, #{emailEnabled}, #{pushEnabled}, #{quietStart}, #{quietEnd}, now()) on duplicate key update websocket_enabled = values(websocket_enabled), email_enabled = values(email_enabled), push_enabled = values(push_enabled), quiet_start = values(quiet_start), quiet_end = values(quiet_end), update_time = now()
